children: Saskatoon, Saskatchewan--(Newsfile Corp. - September 1, 2026) -
Buffalo Potash Corporation
(OTCQB: BLPTF) (FSE: VU5)
(the "
Company
" or "
Buffalo

") is pleased to announce its participation as a presenting company at the ArcStone Kingswood Growth Summit 2026, taking place on Wednesday, September 16, 2026 at the Sheraton Centre Toronto Hotel in Toronto, Ontario.

The ArcStone Kingswood Growth Summit brings together a select group of investors, issuers, family offices, and capital markets professionals. Chief Executive Officer Steve Halabura will present the Company's recent milestones and its development strategy at the Disley Project, including the advancement of Buffalo's patented Horizontal Line-Drive (HLD) solution mining technology at its initial production module ("
IPM
") and the Company's plans for capital-efficient, lower-impact potash production in Saskatchewan.
DTC Eligibility
The Company also announces that its common shares are now eligible for electronic clearing and settlement in the United States through the Depository Trust Company ("
DTC

DTC eligibility is expected to simplify the process of trading and enhance liquidity of Buffalo shares in the United States. The Company's shares recently began trading on the OTCQB® Venture Market ("
OTCQB
") under the ticker symbol BLPTF.

DTC is a subsidiary of the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation, a U.S. company that manages the electronic clearing and settlement of publicly traded companies. Securities that are eligible to be electronically cleared and settled through DTC are considered to be "DTC eligible". This electronic method of clearing securities speeds up the receipt of stock and cash, and thus accelerates the settlement process for investors and brokers, enabling the stock to be traded over a much wider selection of brokerage firms by coming into compliance with their requirements.
The Company's common shares trade on the TSX Venture Exchange under the symbol "
BUFF
", on the OTCQB under the symbol "
BLPTF
", and on the Frankfurt Exchange under the symbol "
VU5
Simply Wall St Pty Ltd
The Company has entered into an advertising and investor awareness agreement (the "
Agreement
") with Simply Wall St Pty Ltd ("
Simply Wall St

"), an Australian company with its principal place of business at Level 5, 320 Pitt Street, Sydney NSW 2000, Australia. Simply Wall St provides investment research, digital media and investor awareness services through its platform and distribution network. Pursuant to the Agreement, Simply Wall St will provide the Company with investor awareness and advertising services over a four (4) month campaign commencing September 1, 2026 and ending December 31, 2026.

In consideration for these services, the Company will pay Simply Wall St C$150,000 in four (4) equal monthly installments of C$37,500 each, payable in Canadian dollars over the term of the campaign. No other fees are payable under the Agreement and the Company will not issue any securities to Simply Wall St in consideration for the services provided under the Agreement.

Simply Wall St is arm's length to the Company. To the knowledge of the Company, neither Simply Wall St nor its principals hold, directly or indirectly, any securities of the Company as of the date of this news release, and Simply Wall St has no right to acquire any such securities.

Certain content produced under the Agreement, including editorial articles, is authored by independent contributors and is prepared and published in Simply Wall St's editorial discretion. Such content represents the views of its authors and Simply Wall St, does not constitute investment advice, and does not necessarily reflect the views of the Company. The commercial and paid nature of the advertising placements will be disclosed by Simply Wall St in accordance with applicable requirements.
About Simply Wall St

Simply Wall St Pty Ltd is an investment research and analysis platform built for long-term investors, providing institutional-quality financial data presented through easy-to-understand visual reports and infographics. The platform serves investors globally, offering company analysis, portfolio tools, and market coverage across listed equities worldwide. More information is available at simplywall.st.
About Buffalo Potash

Buffalo Potash is an emerging Saskatchewan-based potash developer pursuing a modular approach to selective solution mining through its patented Horizontal Line-Drive (HLD) technology. Buffalo is advancing the Disley Project — located adjacent to two of the most prominent currently producing potash solution mines in the world — with the objective of establishing capital-efficient, lower-impact potash production in one of the world's leading potash jurisdictions.
